description: The line plot illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity of three different language models, LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B, as they are pruned by various numbers of layers (denoted as M) at 70% sparsity using the OWL method. The x-axis, labeled 'M', represents the number of layers pruned and is linear, ranging from 3 to 8. The y-axis, labeled 'Perplexity', is also linear and ranges from 20.0 to 40.0. The plot includes three lines, each representing one of the language models. The LLaMA1-7B line is green with circle markers and a solid line style, showing a general increase in perplexity as the number of layers pruned increases. The LLaMA1-13B line is orange with star markers and a solid line style, and it exhibits a relatively stable perplexity across the different numbers of layers pruned. The Vicuna-7B line is blue with triangle markers and a solid line style, and it shows a slight increase in perplexity as the number of layers pruned increases. The plot does not include any section titles or annotations beyond the axes labels and the legend for the lines.
